# taskmd — task contracts with machine-verdict completion

> TASK.md contracts (Acceptance Criteria + Definition of Done) whose completion
> is decided by CODE against a live system (technical_done = AC AND DoD),
> independent of the executing model. The execution sibling of CCDD.
> This page publishes the spec as searchable skills.

## Docs

- [Landing](/index.html)
- [Repository](https://github.com/MauricioPerera/taskmd)
